events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Villarreal 0, Napoli 1. Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Goal! Villarreal 1, Napoli 1. Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Villarreal 2, Napoli 1. Santiago Mouriño (Villarreal) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Gerard Moreno.
Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Rafa Marín (Napoli).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half begins Villarreal 2, Napoli 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Luiz Júnior (Villarreal).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Giovane (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Napoli. Noa Lang replaces Giovane.
Substitution, Napoli. Leonardo Spinazzola replaces Scott McTominay.
Substitution, Napoli. David Neres replaces Matteo Politano.
Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Villarreal. Tani Oluwaseyi replaces Gerard Moreno.
Substitution, Villarreal. Alex Freeman replaces Georges Mikautadze.
Nathan Saliba (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Villarreal. Juan Foyth replaces Alberto Moleiro.
Substitution, Napoli. Stanislav Lobotka replaces Billy Gilmour.
Substitution, Napoli. Lorenzo Lucca replaces Rafa Marín.
Substitution, Villarreal. Ayoze Pérez replaces Santi Comesaña.
Substitution, Villarreal. Sergi Cardona replaces Pape Gueye.
Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Villarreal 3, Napoli 1. Tani Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Ayoze Pérez.
Second Half ends, Villarreal 3, Napoli 1.
